angle: WR/TE break mechanics: Break G (speed shed into the plant and drive out over the second around the first cut) graded by the same code on Combine route drills and matched NFL route families (slant/out/hitch/in/corner), tested against full-season separation over expected on held-out draft classes; revision of the round-21 winner applying all four judges' top_changes.
metric_name: Break G: speed a receiver sheds going into his plant and how hard he drives out, measured over the second around his first cut; scored against peers in the same drill and Combine year, averaged over route drills, shrunk by reliability. On film: in, slowest, out speeds (shed in mph).
headline_number: -1.2 in of season SOE per sd of Break G [90%: -3.8, +1.0], n=116, leave-one-class-out; P(|effect|<3 in)=90%; pooled bootstrap [-3.7, +1.0]; no-tracking baseline R2 0.00 (pick-only -0.03, nested ridge 0.02). Transfer: official 40 -> NFL top speed 0.48 vs Combine -> NFL Break G -0.04 (n=92), official shuttle -> NFL Break G 0.11 (n=42).
what_changed_from_previous: Football: in-text drill-rep vs NFL-rep read for Boutte (sheds 5.3 mph in drill, 1.4 on Sundays: rounds the break), Flournoy and Bobo, mph units, one coach line per receiver plus career SOE; confusing Fig 1 caption cut; 15-cut prescription tied to reliability (0.53 at today's 7 cuts, 0.70 at 15); re-stem labelled an untested design proposal; 40-clip 0.3 s offset handling and missed-season handling stated (23 receivers missed a season; dropping them gives -1.4); Section 2 table cut from 7 to 4 rows; day-3 section cut to a 'film list, not a ranking' with a 4-column table (man/zone, slot/wide in appendix); single bottom-line action for scouts. Data science: 2x2 error-recipe grid reconciles the judge's refit exactly (fit unweighted: 9.7 route-weighted, 15.1 unweighted vs body 8.6/14.9); pick-only and nested-LOCO ridge baselines; pooled (cross-class) bootstrap; Holm note (smallest adjusted p 1.00); 'size of the spread' phrasing replaced with 'equals the 8.6 in sd of career SOE'; shuttle transfer benchmark in the body table. Viz: Fig 1 bottom bars replaced by one dumbbell strip of all 49 eligible WRs (drill vs NFL Break G, named three labelled, legend), thicker traces, two-line panel titles; Fig 2 grouped with section headers (Break G / parts / official times); Fig 3 adds Panel C (official shuttle, no tracking), rings the Fig 1 receivers, label collisions fixed. 1,529 words, 3 figures + 4 tables; verify.py 124/124.
open_risks: Still a null-result paper; the re-stem prescription is explicitly untested.

Raw speed shed and Break G rank disagree for the named cards (Bobo sheds more mph in the drill than Boutte on shared families); the text explains rank is within-drill across all ten drills, but a football judge may still find it confusing.
Coach lines per receiver are hand-written readings of the numbers (guarded by asserts on the shed ordering), not model outputs.
Bobo has no official 40 so only 2 of 3 Fig 1 receivers appear in Fig 3B; the Fig 1 strip rank correlation (0.10, n=49) differs from the 92-receiver -0.04.

New round-22 numbers (baseline grid, ridge, pooled bootstrap, Holm, missed seasons) are computed in analysis.py but not independently re-derived by verify.py; nested ridge picks the top of the penalty grid (intercept-like).
